summary.text: KRAUMAN AS is a private limited company registered in Andenes, founded 2017-06-26. KRAUMAN AS restaurerer og vedlikeholder bygninger, utfører grunnarbeider med anleggsmaskiner og brøyter veier. Its main industry code is 43.120: site preparation. The register shows 12 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 13 625 994 NOK and the annual result was 2 100 609 NOK; operating income was up from 9 707 295 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 1 447 936 NOK in 2024 to 2 100 609 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 9 006 541 NOK in 2024 to 11 107 150 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Kjetil Bjørdal (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is krauman.no, which links to its Facebook profile. The registered employee count went from 11 on 2025-11-13 to 12 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
